items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: A guy that is still one of my close friends John Luebke

ctx.x: Oh of course. You know I’ve got to tell you I remember that whole thing very, very well. A guy that is still one of my close friends John Luebke was one of the Phi Mu Alpha people that got them to sponsor the Kenton band and we did a residency. I think we were there for like three days or something?
